# Changelog - Cache Module

All notable changes to the cache module are documented here.
The format is based on Keep a Changelog.

## [Unreleased]

### Changed
- Documentation governance sync: README, ARCHITECTURE, SECURITY, ROADMAP, FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS, AUDIT, and PERFORMANCE_EXPECTATIONS aligned to source-verifiable module behavior.
- Performance expectations updated to explicit existing benchmark symbols from current cache benchmark sources.

## [1.9.0] - 2026-03-22

### Changed
- lock-free and shared-read hardening in L1 cache paths.

## [1.7.0] - 2026-03-09

### Added
- public cache abstractions and expanded invalidation/security integration.

## [1.6.0] - 2026-02-01

### Added
- distributed replication, SLO monitoring, predictive prefetching, and policy enhancements.

## [1.5.0] - 2026-01-15

### Added
- GDPR-aware invalidation and admin/tenant operational cache APIs.

## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-01

### Added
- foundational adaptive query cache with multi-tier and semantic support.
